patterns.note: Content is presented in distinct, full-width sections, each with a maximum content width centered on the page, creating a clean, structured flow.
Headings are consistently large, bold, and use a modern sans-serif font, often with a secondary, lighter-weight line to provide context or a sub-headline.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is accented by a vibrant, electric blue for interactive elements, key information, and subtle graphic details.
The primary navigation bar at the top and a circular information button at the bottom-right remain fixed in the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections frequently feature a prominent, often abstract, 3D graphic or illustration that visually represents the section's core concept, such as the interconnected network in the hero.

technique_notes: Sections are built with full-width background containers and an inner fixed-width container to center content, ensuring readability on large screens while allowing for full-bleed background elements.
The hero section combines a large, impactful headline with a complex, abstract 3D graphic that serves as a central visual metaphor, surrounded by smaller, related icons.
Interactive elements like buttons and links utilize a high-contrast color (electric blue) against a neutral background (black or white) to clearly indicate their functionality.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) are paired with clear, legible body text and small, often uppercase, labels for secondary information.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — a slight rounding on buttons and card-like elements, but mostly sharp corners for overall structure.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating an airy feel without being sparse.

standout: The site's distinctive use of abstract, high-fidelity 3D graphics as central visual metaphors in key sections, particularly the hero, elevates it beyond typical SaaS marketing. These graphics are not just decorative but integral to communicating complex concepts like interconnectedness and security in a visually engaging way.
